authority: Owner: Employee Mobile Identity rules and Program Lifecycle Business Rules Implementation & Verification

rules.rule: Employee Ledger employee_id represents mobile; normalized mobile is the operational matching key, never the internal relational ID.
Same normalized employee mobile means same operational employee, irrespective of name spelling; retain contradictory ownership evidence for review without silently splitting the mobile identity.
Preserve every original name as an alias with source references; no original name overwrite.
Separate escort_mobile is optional, not required. Existing explicit escortMobile associates with matching employee_id; introduce no duplicate phone column.
Same name with different mobiles remains separate unless an explicitly owner-approved linkage exists.
Require established Employee Ledger or employee/escort mobile source role; sender, master, client, payout and JID/LID are excluded.
Client/authorized requester service order preserves all evidence as Draft; equivalent Draft receives additional evidence, never confirmation solely from a request.
Verified Admin plus Mother, Lighter, name, employee mobile, duty start date and shift promotes/links Draft or creates unmatched confirmation candidate without invented client order.
Same-day same details and matching details within three days are duplicate/correction candidates; preserve all messages and reference existing program.

Same lighter within five days needs cancellation/restart/replacement review; beyond five days new program may be valid with lifecycle evidence. Day five remains review due to inclusive earlier owner rule.
Different lighters under same mother are separate programs; vessel names alone are not permanent physical identities; no mother program-count cap.

Cancellation/restart/correction/replacement append linked evidence events; explicit effective dates only, preserve predecessor assignments and old/new mobile identities; insufficient evidence is Review.
Confirmation, assignment and actual duty start are distinct facts; never mark historical confirmations Active without actual start evidence.
Preserve source occurrence, original reference, sender-role evidence, message timestamp, duty date/shift, fields, applied rule IDs, missing/conflict reasons and linked order/program.
Release OCR is extracted evidence, not approval. Vessel names may be missing; employee mobile, chronology and references propose program matches; ambiguous matches remain Review.
Duty Released, Program Completed, Salary Settlement Approved and Payment Completed are distinct milestones; no invented dates/totals or settlement from release.
New confirmed assignment for same mobile with open prior assignment creates closure review, never fabricated prior release date.
Repeated BDT 200 daily evidence after release may indicate Ghat Duty; require mobile/date/amount/purpose and prior release/assignment context for review.

Three consecutive distinct calendar days of BDT 200 evidence are strong review candidates; distinguish instructions from verified transfers; duplicate evidence does not add days; no financial/attendance posting.

Complete valid unambiguously parsed authorized Admin wa-01 (…6111) to Accountant (…6824) direct-chat successful send is Confirmed and eligible for immediate posting if not already posted; no Accountant reply, receipt, manual verification or additional Admin approval. Attempts, failed or ambiguous sends are not success.
Each valid logical payment block is a separate transaction; retain source spans and parser version; incomplete or ambiguous blocks require Review without discarding valid siblings.
Authenticated permitted Admin frontend entry is directly Confirmed and posted; no additional approver or Accountant verification.

Authenticated authorized Office Assistant, Operations or other Staff frontend entry remains Pending Admin Approval; permitted authenticated Admin approval posts the exact version, rejection does not; user-supplied actor labels never authorize.

Employee ID is normalized source-role-proven employee mobile; payout/contact name/sender/unresolved LID never substitute; same mobile names are aliases, same name distinct mobiles remain separate absent explicit reconciliation; invalid or ambiguous identity is Review.

Genuine distinct instructions/logical blocks remain separate including identical employee/amount/text/minute/day; replay suppression uses established exact source/business-operation identity, not similarity.

Approved target alrifai has one canonical atomic financial posting identity supplying Employee Ledger, Daily Cash, cash-account movements and reports with idempotency, audit and controlled linked reversals; no second writer or execution/cutover authorization here.

Source, authorized send-success, business confirmation, posting and external disbursement proof are separate; external fund-transfer proof is not a WhatsApp posting prerequisite; summaries/deposits/daily totals are not individual employee payments.

Approved Relay sender …1596 original instruction and final Admin wa-01 forwarding to Accountant …6824 correlate as one instruction; final authorized send-success triggers posting, relay receipt/attempt does not; no live relay activation authorized.

Invalid components/unresolved identity or peer/missing send-success/conflicting replay payload require Review or reconciliation; failed sends cannot confirm; corrections/deletions/returns preserve evidence and never silently replace posted records.

Historical archives remain accessible and separate; reconcile source/block/posted-transaction overlap before an Owner-approved import; never add archived instruction totals automatically or fabricate unavailable old/manual records; no restoration prerequisite.

Payments alone do not establish earnings, dues, advances/recoveries, cash inflows or opening balances; unknown basis remains Unknown / Incomplete History, never invented zero; show source coverage/cutoff separately from archives.

implementationSafeguards.rule: Offline candidate reducer only; no database/network/writer/startup hook.
Exact owner-approved source-export/chat/sender/effective-period role binding required; role conflicts fail closed.
Known operational context and non-message correction/OCR/completion decisions require explicit approved source-bound proof; unverified historical statuses are assertions.
Day-five overlap handled conservatively as recurrence review; more-than-five days permits new candidate, never automatic verified identity.

One source message may contain multiple genuine lighter blocks; deterministic event key hashes source occurrence plus original body start line. Replay uniqueness and approval FK use occurrence/role/event key; blank event key retains whole-record scope.
